title: aquilegia scopulorum var. calcarea
intro: Aquilegia scopulorum var. calcarea, commonly known as mountain columbine, is a perennial plant species within the Ranunculaceae family, characterized by its delicate, bell-shaped flowers and unique adaptations to high-altitude environments. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to soothe and calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and infection prevention. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia scopulorum var. calcarea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenes, which can modulate the body's response to stress and promote relaxation. However, further research is necessary to fully understand the bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
